finalCta.paragraph: History: The DW10FC is the Euro 6 evolution of the 2.0-litre diesel, adding SCR/AdBlue technology for emissions compliance while delivering 160-180hp. Fitted to Gen 2 508 Allure, GT and GT Premium trims, it's the performance diesel choice for the liftback and SW estate. The engine appears as AHX or AHS in vehicle documentation.
